narr: Deep moisture and instability in place over Central New York on this day combined with a slow moving upper level disturbance to trigger heavy rain producing thunderstorms. Localized flashed flooding occurred in a few areas with minimal impact to roads.
ev: Thunderstorm rains flooded Franklin Street and the Route 26 underpass near the Cider Mill.
Water was reported running across Oneida Street.
lsr: Franklin Street flooded, route 26 underpass by Cider Mill flooded.
